templates.name: title card: 2-line caps, white top line, red key word, real storm scene
dated stamp: year and place line over a red caps word
object hero with boxed or numbered label, no host
host with camera pole, CAMERA label and red arrow
no text, crash or wreck in scene
no text, single tornado wide shot

constants.typeface: heavy condensed caps (Bebas Neue-like) for the key word on 7 of 12 thumbnails with text; no serif anywhere
constants.colour_pair: white text with a red key word on 7 of 12 texted thumbnails; green only for numbers (12, 17)
constants.host_placement: not fixed: host on 2 of 20 (11, 19), both left of centre
constants.badge: none, except the boxed TWISTEX label on 1
constants.border: none; 14 has thin white dividing lines between panels only
constants.grade: real storm footage with dark or overcast sky and desaturated colour on 17 of 20; 3D renders on 1, 12, 17

host_treatment.lit: flat daylight, no rim light or glow
host_treatment.size: face about 5 to 6 percent of frame width
host_treatment.placement: left of centre, upper to middle height, waist-up crop
host_treatment.gaze: away from camera, at the prop or the storm
host_treatment.prop: camera pole with red arrow and CAMERA label in both
host_treatment.other_people: figures on 3, 8, 15 with faces hidden or unreadable

text_rules.word_count: 1 to 4 words; median 2.5 across the 12 texted thumbnails
text_rules.case: all caps on 9 (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 19); mixed-case first line over caps key word on 10 and 20; title case on 17
text_rules.colours: white plus red key word on 7; white with black outline on 11 and 19; green on 12 and 17; white box on 1
text_rules.position: top centre on 6, 7, 9, 10; right half on 5; left middle on 20; upper right on 1, 12, 17; centre on 2; upper left over the prop on 11 and 19
text_rules.highlight: the key noun (DEATH, TORNADO, UNSURVIVABLE) in red; numbers in green (12, 17)
text_rules.biggest_line: title cards 18 to 21 percent of frame height; labels 7 to 18 percent

popular_vs_latest.popular_text: 7 of 10 popular thumbnails carry text (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10); 3 have none (3, 4, 8)
popular_vs_latest.latest_text: 5 of 10 latest thumbnails carry text (11, 12, 17, 19, 20); 5 have none (13, 14, 15, 16, 18)
popular_vs_latest.popular_content: mostly title cards that repeat or sharpen the video title
popular_vs_latest.latest_content: numbers, a device name and a host label (12, 17, 19, 11) add an idea the title does not state
popular_vs_latest.views: popular 959k to 4.4M; latest 298k to 8.0M; the two highest-view thumbnails (19 at 8.0M, 18 at 4.5M) are both latest

top3.note: 1, 2 and 3 tie at 4.4M; the top 3 by views are 19, 18 and a three-way tie for third
top3.shared: one dominant subject filling the centre or right; no more than one text element (18 and 3 have none); strong dark-to-light contrast; a human-scale cue (host on 19, house and car on 18, car on 3, single word on 2)

transfer: Put one red key word of 1 to 3 caps words over the storm footage on the title card, and use the same red for the key noun. Evidence: 2 (UNSURVIVABLE, 4.4M), 5 (WALL OF DEATH, 3.0M), 9 (THE STRONGEST TORNADO, 1.2M).

For a historic storm, add the year and place as a white line above the red word, and keep it off the title wording. Evidence: 6 (2011 TUSCALOOSA, 2.3M), 20 (2025 St. Louis, 1.8M), 10 (1967 Oak Lawn, 959k).
Show the presenter left of centre, waist up, holding a labelled prop with a red arrow in front of a tornado. Evidence: 19 (8.0M, top of set), 11 (557k, weaker of the two).
Put one number in neon on a 3D or diagram object to show scale. Evidence: 12 (318 MPH, 1.6M), 17 (100 People, 1.7M).
Use one wide funnel with a small house or car for scale and no text. Evidence: 18 (4.5M), 4 (3.5M).

weak.why: plain wide shot, grey and low contrast, no text or focal device; the funnel reads as a distant cloud
2x2 split of four small frames with no single focal point; each panel is too small to read at phone size
pale funnel on a pale sky with no text or contrast cue; the taillights are the only accent
